name: Popped Chips Salt 'n' Pepper
ingredients_raw: POTATO PELLETS {POTATO FLAKES, POTATO STARCH, RICE FLOUR, TAPIOCA STARCH, IODIZED SALT (0.6%), REFINED RICE BRAN OIL}, SEASONING {REFINED RICE BRAN OIL, MALTODEXTRIN, IODIZED SALT (1.6%), MILK SOLIDS, BLACK PEPPER POWDER (0.4%), SUGAR, FLAVOUR ENHANCER (INS 635), ACIDITY REGULATOR (INS 330), NATURE IDENTICAL FLAVOURING SUBSTANCES AND NATURAL FLAVOURS AND NATURAL FLAVOURING SUBSTANCES}, YELLOW PEA GRITS (7.3%) AND GREEN PEA GRITS (7.3%).
